# <span id="aanchor298"></span> Positive Displacement Entry - Daily

This functionality is only available for gas meters.

Use the PD Entry Daily screen to quickly enter positive displacement and turbine meter index readings, single or daily pressures and temperatures, and daily pulse counts or uncorrected volumes from which FLOWCAL will calculate the corrected volume if characteristics and analyses are in place.

Upon creating a new entry, the previous "Off" information (off date, off hour, and off reading) is used as the "On" information for the new entry.

<a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="Entering Data Manually">

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />Entering Data Manually</a>

<div class="drop-down" style="display: none;" mc-target-name="Entering Data Manually">

<div class="procedure">

To enter data in the PD Entry Daily screen:

1.  Go to **Import** \> **Positive Displacement** \> **Daily Entry**.

2.  Select a meter. If the meter is not a positive displacement meter or turbine meter, a warning will display.

3.  Click **New** to enter new index readings.

4.  If no data exists for the meter, the first empty cell will be **On Date**. If there is existing data for the meter, the first empty cell will be **Off Date**.

5.  Enter an on date and on hour.

6.  Enter the on reading.

7.  Enter the three off values the same way you entered the on values. The difference between the on and off readings is automatically calculated. Rollover values are handled by the calculations.

    By default, the reading values and the difference are stored as pulses. To store the readings and differences as raw volume, select that option in **Setup** \> **Meter** \> **Default Values**.

8.  To enter a daily pressure, check the "Daily Pressure" option. To enter a daily temperature, check the "Daily Temperature" option.

9.  Based on the On Date and Off Date values, the row for each day in the date range becomes available for entering daily values. The first column is for pulse count/raw volume entry. Depending on the options selected, the second column is for pressure and the third column is temperature.

10. As daily data is entered, the Daily Volume Running Total field will contain a running sum of the on reading plus each day's pulse count/raw volume.

11. Click **Save** to import the pulse count/raw volume, pressure, and temperature data.

    To use this function, the Transaction Queue service must be installed and running.

    

<img src="data:image/png;base64," class="ScreenShot" style="width: 621;height: 458;" />

</div>

</div>

<a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="Parameters">

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />Data Entry Parameters</a>

<div class="drop-down" style="display: none;" mc-target-name="Parameters">

| Field | Format Requirements |
|----|----|
| On Date/Off Date | 6 numeric digits (MMDDYY) |
| On Hour/Off Hour | 2 numeric digits (HH); use a leading 0 for single-digit hours |
| On Reading/Off Reading | Number of digits corresponds to the number of dials on the meter; this value is set in Meter Characteristics; if no value is specified, the default number is 6 |

</div>

<a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="Read Tolerances">

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />Read Tolerances</a>

<div class="drop-down" style="display: none;" mc-target-name="Read Tolerances">

Read tolerances (in days) may be set for monthly records on the **Meter Editor** \> **Reports** tab. Records with an actual (entered) on date within the read tolerance will be snapped to contract start of month. Records with an actual (entered) off date within the read tolerance will be snapped to the contract end of month.

PD Entry Daily will not save:

- Long records with on or off dates outside the read tolerances.
- Records dated in the future. Both the on and off dates must occur before the date of entry. Off dates must occur after on dates.

</div>
